cases.name: opening selection and typing along a word
solve one word correctly, watch the cursor move on
wrong letters then a word check
selectSlot lands on the first empty cell of the word
pencil letters never complete and never count
hints: letter, word, then refuse when nothing left in the word
typing into a locked cell skips it
starter gift fills the opening word and moves to a crosser
give up fills everything and completes
restore with a locked letter and a pencil mark
daily: finish the shortest word, cursor prefers a crosser

description: GameViewModel driven by input scripts against bundled puzzles (loaded by id from the shared puzzles.json). `state` after init is step 0. Entries: uppercase = player letter, lowercase = hint-locked.
